task: regression: peptide-receptor binding affinity as pKd = 9 - log10(Kd [nM]); higher = tighter binding
architecture: frozen ESM2-150M masked-mean-pooled vector per chain, concat(target, binder) 1280-d -> Linear(256) -> ReLU -> Dropout(0.1) -> Linear(1); MSE on pKd, output bias initialised to the training mean pKd
esm_embedding: mean over every attended token including BOS/EOS; the notebook encoded under fp16 autocast, the platform runs fp32 (vectors differ in the 3rd decimal)
weights_layout: baseline_split_cluster.pt, baseline_split_random.pt (each {state, best, best_epoch}), receptors.json (human UniProt sequences), metadata.json

training_data.sources: PPB-Affinity (proteinea/ppb_affinity, raw_rec) merged with PPI-affinity; duplicates collapsed to the median pKd, PPI taking precedence
training_data.mostly: protein-protein complexes (median target length 223 aa); only PPI-affinity contributes short peptides (median 12 aa)

splits.split_cluster: whole groups, CD-HIT clusters of the chains with complexes grouped by target cluster

metrics.StdPeptide: 94 measurements of 62 distinct peptides against human GLP-1R, GCGR and GIPR; no model trained or validated on them
